questions.prompt: Nzi yuko bazagaruka ejo. Bazasubira i Kigali ejo bundi.
questions.answer: I know they will return tomorrow. They will go back to Kigali day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Tuzabareba kuko bazaba benshi, ariko abandi bazaba bake.
questions.answer: We will see them because they will be many, but the others will be (only) a few.

questions.prompt: Mbese uzabikora ejo? Oya, ndabikora none.
questions.answer: Will you do it tomorrow? No, I will do it today.

questions.prompt: Nona arabikora kinyarwanda. Ejo azobikora kizungu. Mbese, si byiza?
questions.answer: Today he does it in Kinyarwanda style. Tomorrow he will do it like the other white people. Isn't that good?

questions.prompt: Bariya bantu benshi bazakora ejo ku manywa. Aba barakora none.
questions.answer: Those mahy people will work tomorrow in the afternoon. These (people) will work today.

questions.prompt: Nzashaka kuva mu mujyi. Nzi yuko nzabikora.
questions.answer: I will want to leave the city. I know that I will do so.

questions.prompt: Ibi bijumba si byiza; azashaka ibinini kuko azabibika mu gikoni.
questions.answer: These sweet potatoes are not good; he/she will want big ones, because he/she will store them in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: Si byiza kurya umutsima gusa; ukwiriye kurya n'(a) imboga
questions.answer: It's not good to eat bread only; you must eat vegetables also.

questions.prompt: Bamwe bazaba hanze; abandi bazaba mu nzu y'umutware.
questions.answer: Some (people) will be outside; others will be in the chief's house.

questions.prompt: Mbese, ejo ntimuzaba muri aha? Oya, tuzagaruka ejo bundi.
questions.answer: Will you not be here tomorrow? No, we will return the day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Dukunda kurya imboga n'umutsima, ariko abandi ntibabikunda.
questions.answer: We like to eat vegetables and bread, but other's don't like it.

questions.prompt: Aba bantu ndabizi. Bazakora kigabo. N'abakozi beza cyane.
questions.answer: I know these people. They work like men. They are very good workers.

questions.prompt: Kirya kigabo kiravuga kigabo, ariko kizakora kigore. Ndakizi.
questions.answer: That hulk of a man is speaking like a man, but he will work like a woman. I know him.

questions.prompt: Nzagaruka ejo mu gitondo kuko ubu nkwiriye gusubira iwacu.
questions.answer: I'll come back tomorrow in the morning, because I must return home now.

questions.prompt: Nzi neza yuko Imana yacu izadukiza. Impumyi zizareba.
questions.answer: I well know that our God will save us. The blind will see, and the dumb will hear.

questions.prompt: Petero ari he? Simbizi, ariko nzi yuko azagaruka.
questions.answer: Where is Peter? I don't know, but I know that he will return [far future].

questions.prompt: Isake izabika ejo mu gitondo. Tuzayumva twese.
questions.answer: The rooster will crow tomorrow morning. We will all hear it.

questions.prompt: Bazi yuko abana bazasakuza cyane. Abantu bose bazabumva.
questions.answer: They know that the children will make a lot of noise. Everyone will hear them.

questions.prompt: Va mu nzira, umwami aragaruka none.
questions.answer: Get out of the way; the king is coming back today.
